row.diff:
diff --git a/orders.py b/orders.py
index a658bf8..388d28a 100644
--- a/orders.py
+++ b/orders.py
@@ -8,9 +8,14 @@ def read_lines(path):
 
 
 def line_total(line):
-    """Price times quantity for one line of the sheet, in cents."""
+    """Price times quantity for one line of the sheet, in cents.
+
+    Staff only write a quantity when it is more than one, so a blank or
+    missing quantity counts as 1.
+    """
     price = round(float(line["price"]) * 100)
-    qty = int(line["qty"])
+    raw_qty = (line.get("qty") or "").strip()
+    qty = int(raw_qty) if raw_qty else 1
     return price * qty
 
 
diff --git a/tests/test_orders.py b/tests/test_orders.py
index 97ea6a4..1bf894a 100644
--- a/tests/test_orders.py
+++ b/tests/test_orders.py
@@ -14,3 +14,15 @@ def test_read_lines(tmp_path):
     p = tmp_path / "o.csv"
     p.write_text("item,price,qty\nJam,3.20,2\n", encoding="utf-8")
     assert orders.read_lines(p) == [{"item": "Jam", "price": "3.20", "qty": "2"}]
+
+
+def test_line_total_blank_qty_is_one():
+    assert orders.line_total({"price": "2.50", "qty": ""}) == 250
+    assert orders.line_total({"price": "2.50", "qty": "  "}) == 250
+    assert orders.line_total({"price": "2.50", "qty": None}) == 250
+
+
+def test_order_total_with_blank_qty(tmp_path):
+    p = tmp_path / "o.csv"
+    p.write_text("item,price,qty\nJam,3.20,2\nTea,1.00,\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    assert orders.order_total(orders.read_lines(p)) == 740
